# FirstCompile

> FirstCompile is an AI-native software company that designs, engineers, and ships
> production-grade software for startups and businesses in India, the United States,
> and worldwide. AI accelerates delivery; engineers make every decision that matters.

## Services

For startups:
- MVP development — idea to a live product users can pay for, in weeks.
- Startup tech partner — FirstCompile runs product and engineering for startups without a CTO.
- Vibe-code to production — prototypes built fast with AI tools (Cursor, Lovable, Bolt, v0)
  made secure, stable, and ready to scale.
- AI app security audit — a full security review of an AI-generated codebase, with a
  written report in 5 working days.

Startups can also engage every service listed below.

For businesses:
- Custom ERP & CRM — business software shaped around how a company actually runs.
- Application development — web platforms, portals, and internal tools, including
  Shopify and WordPress builds and migrations.
- AI & machine learning — practical AI in production: search, document
  intelligence, forecasting, with cost ceilings built in.
- Custom AI agents — agents that take real actions in a company's tools, with
  approvals, limits, and audit logs.
- Workflow automation — integrations and background jobs with retries and
  monitoring, so nothing fails silently.
- Data & business intelligence — one source of truth for company numbers.
- Industry 4.0 & industrial automation — machine monitoring, plant dashboards,
  and control software for factories.
- Mobile apps — iOS and Android from one codebase.
- Cloud & DevOps — deployments, environments, and monitoring done properly.
- SEO & GEO — visibility on Google and in AI assistant answers, through technical work.
- Technology consulting — architecture reviews, audits, and build-vs-buy decisions.

## Products FirstCompile builds and runs itself

- ShipFlow — https://shipflow.garvitoberoi.com — multi-tenant delivery automation: a
  customer ticket through requirements, task breakdown, and a developer board, with every
  pull request reviewed by two models from different vendors before a human opens it.
  In private beta.
- NEXUS — https://nexus.garvitoberoi.com — one workspace across mail, calendar,
  repositories, issues, and documents, with an assistant that performs real operations in
  those systems instead of describing them.

Both are built and owned by FirstCompile, not client work. Engineering write-ups for each:
https://firstcompile.com/work

## How FirstCompile works

- Every project is quoted as one fixed price, in writing, before work starts.
  The price does not change after kickoff. There is no hourly billing.
- The client's repository holds the code from the first commit, in the client's own
  GitHub organisation, with full IP assignment.
- A mutual NDA is signed before the client shares anything, as standard.
- Every project includes a 30-day post-launch window in which anything FirstCompile
  built that breaks is fixed at no cost.
- Clients see a working, clickable build from the end of week one, not status decks.
- US and international clients are billed in USD; Indian clients in INR with GST.

## Technologies

Web: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js. Mobile: React Native, Expo, Flutter.
Platforms: Shopify, WordPress, WooCommerce. Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, BigQuery.
AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, pgvector. Cloud: AWS, GCP, Vercel, Docker, Kubernetes.
Industrial: MQTT, Modbus, TimescaleDB, Grafana.

## What "AI-native" means at FirstCompile

AI handles mechanical volume: boilerplate, tests, migrations, refactors. Engineers make
every decision that is expensive to reverse: data models, permissions, anything touching
money or personal data, interface design, and the final review of every change.
AI-built is not the same as vibe-coded: FirstCompile ships production-grade systems.
